title: 👎🏻Aplikasinya sangat bermasalah—jangan membelinya!
body:
Ketika saya menonaktifkan notifikasi pagi dan malam di pengaturan, hanya menyisakan pemberitahuan khusus tugas, aplikasi Anda tetap mengirimkan notifikasi pagi dan malam. Sinkronisasi antara perangkat tidak berfungsi dengan baik. Bahkan jika saya menandai tugas sebagai selesai di satu perangkat, notifikasi tidak menghilang di perangkat lain, sehingga saya harus membuka aplikasi dan menandai tugas tersebut sebagai selesai di sana juga—karena tidak tersinkronisasi. Terkait penggunaan Firebase untuk sinkronisasi antar perangkat—itu adalah pilihan Anda. Namun, pengguna juga seharusnya memiliki hak untuk memilih (baik iCloud atau Firebase Anda). Anda tidak memberikan pilihan tersebut, dan kami tidak akan bertahan atau mentolerir kualitas buruk yang saat ini ada di aplikasi Anda. The app is incredibly buggy—do not buy it! When I disable the morning and evening notifications in the settings, leaving only task-specific alerts, your app still sends the morning and evening notifications. Synchronization between devices does not work properly. Even if I mark a task as completed on one device, the notification does not disappear on the other device, forcing me to open the app and mark the task as completed there as well—because it does not synchronize. Regarding the use of Firebase for synchronization between devices—that is your choice. However, users should also have the right to choose (either iCloud or your Firebase). You did not provide that choice, and we are not going to endure or tolerate the poor quality that currently exists in your app.
UPDATE REVIEW: You are not the first developers to implement cross-platform functionality. However, other smart developers have included options in their app settings to choose between Dropbox or iCloud. In your app, there is no such choice. You imposed Firebase as the only option, and it doesn't even work properly. Synchronization fails when the app is closed on another device—it won't pull in the data until you manually open the app, and as a result, push notifications remain active on other devices even if actions were taken on the first one. Moreover, even after opening the app on other devices and waiting for a long time, synchronization often doesn't occur. This is clear evidence that you chose the wrong platform for synchronization and failed to ensure its proper functioning in your app. The app is poorly designed, and your responses here will not fix that.

Another useless update has been released, but the issue still hasn't been fixed. The app and the developers are subpar.
Still terrible syncing between devices

title: Не рекомендую!
body:
Приложение ужасно глючное! Синхронизацию разработчик навязал через свои серверы, не дав выбора пользователю, чтобы мы могли выбирать сами кому через их сервис, а кто предпочитает через личный аккаунт iCloud. Именно по этой причине не синхронизируется информация между устройствами и даже уведомления чтобы скрыть на другом устройстве, вам нужно отметить задачу выполненной не только на основном устройстве, но и на том куда синхронизируется информация. Иными словами, чтобы синхронизация заработала — вас принуждают открыть приложение. Но и открыв его и подождав полчаса, часто не синхронизируется информация.
Разработчик не желает дать выбор (синхронизировать через iCloud или DropBox или иной сервис) пользователю, а внедрили самый кривой и нерабочий. 
Не мучайтесь — не устанавливайте этот приложение!
